overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Alpine 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna combines 6 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels with 2 Near IR Elements, providing a soothing heat that promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood, it features an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity, allowing you to enjoy a personalized spa experience in spaces like basements or fitness rooms. With its easy clasp-together assembly and clear tempered glass accents, the Maxxus Alpine is both a functional and stylish addition to your wellness routine.
